name: MET Norway Locationforecast (point weather forecast, worldwide)
short: Hourly point forecasts for any latitude and longitude, JSON, free and keyless with a User-Agent. CC BY 4.0.
summary: The Norwegian Meteorological Institute serves api.met.no. Locationforecast 2.0 returns a forecast timeseries for any coordinate: air temperature, pressure, humidity, cloud fraction, wind speed and direction, precipitation and a weather symbol, hourly then 6-hourly, as GeoJSON-style JSON. A call for lat 60, lon 10 on 2026-11-07 answered 200 with updated_at 17:28:51Z. Strongest for the Nordics where the model is high resolution; global elsewhere. It is a forecast model, not a station observation, so it fills coverage gaps with modelled values only.

tasks: point forecast timeseries for any coordinate (temperature, wind, pressure, humidity, cloud, precipitation)

coverage.notes: Model forecast, not measurements. Highest quality over Norway and the Nordic countries; global grid elsewhere.

rate_limit.notes: Terms of service: keep total traffic below 20 requests per second; cache locally; identify with a User-Agent.

delivery.basis: Live GET 2026-11-07: meta.updated_at 2026-11-07T17:28:51Z, response headers Last-Modified 18:19Z and Expires about 30 minutes later.

latency.notes: Response carries an Expires header; the terms ask you to respect it.

licensing.summary: CC BY 4.0 with attribution, stated on the terms of service page (api.met.no/doc/TermsOfService): give appropriate credit, link the licence, say if changed. Requests must carry an identifying User-Agent, traffic must stay under 20 requests per second, and identical requests should be cached per the Expires header; blocked otherwise. Redistribution and AI training are not separately addressed.

time.unknown: Report time is the provider's own stamp.

location.unknown: Fixed station or event coordinates; not independently checked.
location.method: Coordinates in the request are snapped to the model grid.

content.unknown: A forecast, not an observation; values are unverified against reality.

human.unknown: Not applicable: automated instruments or official analysis, not people.

application.unknown: No signing or attestation from instrument to API is documented.

camera.unknown: Not applicable: no camera frames in this feed.

corroboration.unknown: Nothing documented independently confirms individual readings.

auth.how_to_get: No key. Send a User-Agent that identifies your app and contact, as the terms require.

endpoints.notes: Main parameters only; 'complete' returns more fields (not called).

api.rate_limits: Under 20 requests per second; cache and honour Expires.
api.notes: JSON. Identifying User-Agent required; browsers must identify the site instead.
